corrections.Raw_text:
I love the selection of beautiful household decorations. I’ve been delighted with the two area rugs I have bought from Lulu and Georgia. I have some furniture, rugs, and gifts on order waiting to receive.
The only reason why I am giving a 4 and not a five is for two reasons. One the shipping g charges are astronomical which makes it even hard to afford items when they are on sale because the discount actually goes to the shipping.
Secondly, I think being able to talk to a human voice for customer service makes me feel better. Just that personal touch will go a long way! That being said I do get an email back when I do have a question or a concern. However I would love to talk to a designer or representative about your products and design.
All in all you carry beautiful original things you won’t see everyone have. That makes your company unique. 😍
Thanks,

corrections.Raw_text: "Meh," was my reaction after the Mojave Round Table was set up in my kitchen. There are visible black streaks in the legs of the table, along with weird stark white streaks on the top that don't look like naturally grained wood. The odd streaks (of black and white) make this table look odd and for the price tag of $1798, I would not recommend it. I told my husband I wanted it to stain it to make it look more natural and cohesive. Since we're at the mercy of needing a table, in the midst of this supply issue we're in, we decided to keep it out of necessity. I gave this table 2 stars because it still functions as table, is steady, and the design is beautiful. The persons who also delivered it were friendly and professional. I'd pass on this though if given other options.

I have been a decorator for over 30 years and I have never had a company that works with the trade so dismissive and irresponsible
My marble top table arrived broken in 4 large pieces. After months of sending photographs of the table, the boxes it arrived in, the crate… I was told I would receive a replacement. This was over a year ago.
My attempted calls and messages are never returned nor are my emails.
I’m sure they are fine to work with, but Candace, who works with the trade clients is not some one I would recommend working with. Ever.

I ordered a disc pillow several weeks ago, and it's still not here. Ironically, I paid full price for it, too. The boucle ball I ordered a few weeks, finally arrived last week, quite misshapen.
I love the look of your products, so I'm hoping this delivery was not the norm.
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Helen,
We thank you for reaching out. Typically Orders that are NOT Made to order have an estimated lead time of 14-18 business days/2-3 weeks from the purchase date as shared on our shipping page. Please keep in mind these are estimated time frames provided by the vendor and can vary due to production and fulfillment. Once the order has been fulfilled and shipped you will receive the tracking details. Unfortunately, our vendors do not offer expedited shipping and that is why we are unable to offer it as an option on-site.
We see both of your items have been delivered. We hope you're happy with your purchase! If you have any further questions or concerns, please reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
